justification: The only shared content is the human figure: A shows a single large bearded head and shoulders in profile with a tall headdress, elaborate curled hair, ear ornament and patterned garment, rendered with careful naturalistic detail; B shows several tiny stick-like frontal figures with splayed hands and feet, holding long lances, plus a spiral disc and a boat. Beyond the generic presence of people there is no correspondence in posture, attributes, arrangement or drawing convention — one is a monumental portrait bust in profile, the other a schematic multi-figure scene.
